name: Aminatou, the Fateshifter
oracle_text:
+1: Draw a card, then put a card from your hand on top of your library.
−1: Exile another target permanent you own, then return it to the battlefield under your control.
−6: Choose left or right. Each player gains control of all nonland permanents other than Aminatou controlled by the next player in the chosen direction.
Aminatou, the Fateshifter can be your commander.
blocked_sentences: −6: Choose left or right. Each player gains control of all nonland permanents other than Aminatou controlled by the next player in the chosen direction.

needs.what: A 'choose left or right' decision whose answer is bound, plus a player spec 'the next player in the chosen direction' relative to a for_each_player binding (seat-order neighbour: left = next in turn order, right = previous), so that inside for_each_player a gain_control can take objects {controller: <neighbour of each_player>, not_types: [Land], exclude_self: true} with player = each_player. All control changes must be simultaneous (the permanents are snapshotted before any control moves), otherwise the rotation cascades.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_player picks an arbitrary player, not a seat-relative neighbour; for_each_player + gain_control can hand each player objects, but no player spec or selector key (controller/owner/binding) expresses 'the next player to the left/right of the bound player', and sequential per-player gain_control would re-read already-moved permanents instead of rotating the board simultaneously
